segments.text: There's one task on your list you keep dodging. The big, ugly, important one. Brian Tracy has a name for it: your frog.
It's the email still marked unread after six days. You'll clear everything else and still carry that one home in your bag.
And it doesn't wait politely. The frog gets heavier every hour you leave it sitting there.
So here's the rule: eat that frog first. Do the ugliest, most important task before anything else. Win the morning, win the day.
